prompt: Create duration.py with parse_duration(text) that turns things like "1h 30m", "45s", "2h", "1h5m10s" and "90m" into a number of seconds (an int). Spaces are optional, units are h, m and s, and each unit may appear once at most. Empty or wrong input (like "", "abc", "5x", "1h 1h") raises ValueError. Also add test_duration.py with tests, and run them.
